user.title: Connect to Grafana
user.description: Enter your Grafana server's address and a Service Account Token from a service account with the Editor role (Administration → Users and access → Service accounts).

database.title: PostgreSQL database
database.description: Enter the PostgreSQL database Grafana uses (e.g. on the same VM). Home Assistant will create a table in it and write location data directly to it.

dashboard.title: Choose dashboard
dashboard.description: Pick an existing Grafana dashboard to add the location panels to, or create a new one. Also enter the uid of the PostgreSQL datasource in Grafana that points at the database above (found under Connections → Data sources → click the datasource → the uid is in the URL). An Editor service account cannot create data sources, so it must already exist.

data.dashboard_title: Name for new dashboard (if creating one)

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or insufficiently privileged Grafana service account token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Grafana at the given address.
error.pg_cannot_connect: Could not connect to PostgreSQL with the given details.
error.dashboard_failed: Could not create or update the dashboard in Grafana. Check that the service account token has the Editor role and that the datasource uid is correct.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one connection to Grafana can be configured.
